To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The influence of microclimate and microtopography on plant species richness and community composition in alpine vegetation is mediated by the influence of geomorphology; 2) The effect of microclimate on plant species richness was more important than that of microtopography; 3) The effect of geomorphology on plant species richness depended on microtopography; and 4) The effect of the interaction between geomorphology and microtopography depended on microclimate.

(a) microclimatic and geomorphological variables are important determinants of plant communities, and that (b) microclimate and geomorphism are not independent factors, but are closely linked to each other, which is reflected in the spatial patterns of plant communities.

the influence of geomorphological factors and climate on the spatial distribution of plant species in alpine vegetation in Switzerland and the Alps.
